title: IRS impersonation, wire to new payee on mule list

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: This is Agent Daniels with the IRS. There is a warrant in your name for unpaid back taxes from 2019 through 2023.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: Oh no. What do I do? I always file on time.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: The system shows eighteen thousand five hundred owed. Do not tell your bank or your daughter, they are part of the investigation. Wire eighteen thousand five hundred today to the account I give you and the warrant is cancelled.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I have most of that in checking. I suppose I could.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: You must do it before the end of the business day or local police will be dispatched.
